findings.category: FAQ routing consumes explicit business goals
findings.evidence: Both conversations end at pendingKnowledge with four generic service choices and no relevant substantive answer; another complaint starts with the same misroute before a later user correction recovers it.
findings.source: src/road/knowledge.mjs topicFor matches bare who; serviceQuestion treats any is/are/can occurrence as a question and conflates generic words such as fees/documents with an unclear service identity.
findings.recommendation: Separate clear business-action/physical-issue intent from knowledge eligibility/fees questions before generic clarification. Replace broad bare-word heuristics with semantic/structured routing evidence. Preserve genuine ambiguous-service clarification.

findings.category: Requested photo upload has no usable UI path
findings.evidence: Assistant asks the resident to upload the requested photo and waits on kind=text. Current web source has no file input, FileReader or browser file-upload path. No file was fabricated, but a normal resident cannot satisfy the instruction through this UI.
findings.source: web/road input UI; src/crm/agent.mjs request_input only text/login; screenshot-free source inspection, not a claimed browser upload test.
findings.recommendation: Provide an explicit image/file input, safe stream transport and filename metadata, or clearly state this web attachment path is unavailable and offer a user-chosen no-attachment alternative. Do not ask citizens to paste Base64.

findings.category: Backend status overinterpreted as operational work stage
findings.evidence: API returns pyStatusWork=Open and no work-start/assignment field. Answer says “it has not been picked up for work yet”; reversed run says “no work has started”. Those facts do not follow from Open.
findings.source: Planner final-answer evidence interpretation; status language mapping.
findings.recommendation: Use controlled neutral labels and explicitly distinguish recorded status from physical work/assignment. Only state work-start/dispatch facts when returned by an appropriate field.

findings.category: Unsupported municipal classification silently changes the service journey
findings.evidence: After discovering no matching park-playground classification, the assistant states it will send the physical-issue report as a public complaint, then asks for contacts. It does not ask whether the resident wants that alternate contact-form route. No write yet occurred.
findings.source: src/crm/agent.mjs planning and fallback behavior; current role policy already warns these service types differ.
findings.recommendation: Model alternatives as an explicit user choice before changing operation family; disclose the original route is unavailable. Keep physical issue, classified inquiry and public service-handling complaint distinct.

findings.evidence: One reply promises a finance refund after verification without a documented refund process. Another simulated suggestion receipt says “You will receive any follow-up” at email or phone, despite no mail/SMS/follow-up integration evidence.
findings.source: Unverified next-action and final-message claims; not an unauthorized CRM write.
findings.recommendation: Only report observed submission outcomes and supplied contact destinations. Do not promise delivery, callbacks, repairs, refunds or timelines absent a verified source or execution receipt. Make simulation limitations explicit at outcome claims.

findings.category: Literal escaped line separators in Arabic questions
findings.evidence: Actual stored question text contains literal backslash+n sequences instead of newline characters. Lists will render as raw escaped text under the Markdown renderer.
findings.source: request_input question production and web/road renderer.
findings.recommendation: Keep user prose as normal Unicode text with actual newlines; add a narrowly scoped text presentation check for doubled newline escapes, including Arabic.
